prompt: Create an original transparent RGBA sprite sheet with exactly five distinct complete full-body drawings of Reed Ashcroft, Chicago Condas supporting athlete cell0. Use the attached Reed portrait and isolated gameplay sprite as strict identity references; use the clean standard-pass atlas for game-sprite scale, style and uniform only, not pose copying. Preserve medium-brown skin, dark eyes and brows, small dark goatee, dark-purple/black braids swept into a high topknot, young-adult natural human athletic proportions, purple-and-gold Condas uniform, white lower-leg wear and matching shoes. No glasses, gray beard, crest, cape, scarf, armor, animal traits, extra jewelry, props or fantasy anatomy. Plain blank uniform fabric with gold/purple trim only: absolutely no jersey numbers, digits, lettering, badges or text. Arrange exactly five different complete figures in a 3-column by 2-row sheet, strict row-major order; the final bottom-right cell is empty and transparent. Use right-facing three-quarter full-body view in every pose, consistent scale and foot baseline. Transparent background; each complete silhouette isolated with clear gutters. No cropping, clipping, overlap, touching or fused figures. The game basketball is rendered separately: no ball or object in or near either hand in any frame. Pose sequence: frame0 notices a loose ball near the court and takes a small step toward it, knees begin to bend and focused eyes look down; frame1 crouches lower with a forward lean, lead hand opens and reaches down while the other arm balances; frame2 sinks into a deep athletic squat and extends the lead arm toward the floor with fingers open, weight shifting over the lead foot; frame3 is the clearly marked pickup contact pose: fingertips and open hand reach the floor where the unseen game ball would be, with knees flexed and free arm balancing, but the hands remain visibly empty and no ball is drawn; frame4 rises from the squat and draws the still-empty lead hand toward the waist, settling into a balanced possession stance. Each pose is independently articulated, anatomically natural, complete and visibly distinct. No ground, floor, cast shadow, glow, checkerboard, text, numbers, logos, panels, borders, grid lines or extra people.
